findings.title: Compassionate provision through progressive care
findings.claim: The Rabb named in 1:2 can be heard as progressively bringing dependents toward completion, with the surrounding mercy and sought aid making that lordship a form of compassionate provision.
findings.mechanism: The focus Rabb carrier holds the stepwise-development facet; the independent 1:3 mercy and 1:5 assistance connections supply the affective and practical conditions that turn development into sustained care.
findings.reader_payoff: The title Rabb becomes an active process of being formed and sustained, not only a static title of authority.
findings.containment: The primary reading remains the Lord of all worlds. This bounded finding does not activate the omitted repair, irrigation, guardianship, or bestowed-well-being branches and does not claim that Rabb lexically means mercy or aid.

epistemic.reason: The candidate supports and focus branch are trusted/accepted, while the context relations are connection-level and the broader channel branches lack carrier occurrences.

findings.containment: The primary reading remains praise belonging to Allah, Lord of the worlds. No named city, legal locality, or omitted standing-place branch is asserted.

findings.mechanism: The focus proper-name facet is carried by Allah, and the exact 1:1 prefatory connection independently places divine naming immediately before the focus, turning reference into a personal address relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The praise is heard as directed speech to an identifiable addressee rather than as a free-floating statement about divinity.
findings.containment: The primary remains the unique divine name governing the praise. The packet does not activate the omitted oath, vocative, or namesake branches, and the prefatory formula may retain its ordinary formulaic role.

epistemic.reason: The focus proper-name branch is qualified and the prefatory connection is exact at ayah level, but no target morphology is supplied for 1:1.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Praise is newly audible as speech directed to the named divine recipient.
branch_activations.boundary: No oath or vocative formula is inferred from the proper name alone.

findings.reader_payoff: Alamin becomes more than an undifferentiated collection: the worlds can function as marks through which a straight course is recognized.
findings.containment: The primary meaning of worlds remains intact. The omitted road, custom, straightness, and apparatus branches are not activated, and this finding does not claim that alamin translates as road.

epistemic.reason: The focus sign branch is qualified and the route trigger is an exact connection row whose target morphology is explicitly absent.

branch_activations.boundary: The focus word remains worlds; road and straightness are contextual effects, not its sole lexical gloss.

findings.title: The praised recipient as worshipped one
